title: Device for combined transmission of energy and electric signals

features.item: A housing containing a displaceable magnet and pole shoes with workpiece contact surfaces.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer for transmitting electrical energy and signals, not a magnetic gripper with a housing, displaceable magnet, and pole shoes for workpiece contact.

features.item: A magnet displaceable along a direction between a gripping position and a release position.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer with primary and secondary coils and antennas, not a displaceable magnet for gripping and releasing.

features.item: Pole shoes attached to the housing, each with a workpiece contact surface.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer, which does not include pole shoes with workpiece contact surfaces.

features.item: Pole shoes designed to guide a magnetic field portion to the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer, not pole shoes designed to guide a magnetic field to a workpiece.

features.item: A workpiece contact surface defining a contact surface angle of 170° to 190° with the displacement direction.
features.note: This reference does not describe a workpiece contact surface or a displacement direction.

features.item: A magnetic gripper with housing, displaceable magnet, and pole shoes where contact surface angle is 170° to 190° relative to displacement direction.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer, not a magnetic gripper with these specific components and angles.

features.item: A magnetic gripper system with a magnetic gripper and ferromagnetic workpiece, where magnet in gripping position presses workpiece against contact surfaces by magnetic force.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer for energy and signal transmission, not a magnetic gripper system for holding a workpiece.

features.item: Housing extending along a longitudinal axis with displacement direction parallel to that axis.
features.note: This reference does not describe a housing with a longitudinal axis and a parallel displacement direction for a magnet.

features.item: Pole shoes with an active structure for directing the magnetic field portion.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer, not pole shoes with active structures for directing magnetic fields.

features.item: An active structure with a bevel defining a bevel angle of 5° to 85° with the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: This reference does not describe active structures, bevels, or workpiece contact surfaces.

features.item: An active structure with multiple projections for directing magnetic field and forming the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: This reference does not describe active structures with projections for directing magnetic fields or forming workpiece contact surfaces.

features.item: Adjacent first and second projections with a recess between them, recess depth or length deviating by at most 25% from projection length.
features.note: This reference does not describe projections or recesses related to magnetic gripping.

features.item: A positioning device on the magnetic gripper for positioning the ferromagnetic workpiece on the contact surface.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer, not a magnetic gripper with a positioning device for a workpiece.

features.item: First and second pole shoes where the magnet in gripping position makes the first pole shoe act as north pole and second as south pole.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer, not pole shoes with defined north and south poles in a gripping context.

features.item: A magnet displaceable electrically, pneumatically, or mechanically between gripping and release positions.
features.note: This reference does not describe a displaceable magnet or gripping/release positions.

features.item: A position sensor detecting gripping position and/or release position, or a workpiece sensor detecting the ferromagnetic workpiece.
features.note: This reference does not describe sensors for gripping positions or workpiece detection.

features.item: Housing with a receptacle for receiving a workpiece sensor and/or a supply line.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer, not a housing with a receptacle for a workpiece sensor or supply line in the context of magnetic gripping.

features.item: A manipulator interface on the magnetic gripper for attaching to a manipulator.
features.note: This reference describes a transformer, not a magnetic gripper with a manipulator interface.

features.item: Housing portion designed to suppress magnetic field escape, or a shielding device to at least partially prevent magnetic field escape.
features.note: While the reference mentions a core of ferromagnetic material for a transformer, it does not describe a housing portion or shielding device specifically designed to suppress magnetic field escape in the context of a magnetic gripper.

features.item: At least one projection with length deviating by at most 25% from the thickness of the ferromagnetic workpiece.
features.note: This reference does not describe projections or ferromagnetic workpieces.

features.item: A receptacle in the form of a groove in the housing.
features.note: This reference does not describe a receptacle in the form of a groove in a housing.

features.item: A bevel angle of 15° to 75° between the active structure bevel and the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: This reference does not describe active structures, bevels, or workpiece contact surfaces.

features.item: A bevel angle of 40° to 60° between the active structure bevel and the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: This reference does not describe active structures, bevels, or workpiece contact surfaces.
